english.quote: 4.2.3 Applicants must possess strong English language proficiency. Those whose native language is not English must provide official English language proficiency test results (e.g. TOEFL/IELTS/others).
english.notes: Computer Science is a Chinese-English-taught programme (Fees page). Required: 'Chinese language proficiency at HSK Level 5 or above, with scores above 60 in each of the following categories: Listening, Reading, and Writing' (4.2.1, waiver possible for native Chinese speakers / Chinese-medium schools). An English test result is required but no minimum score is published. 2027 admissions cycle (age rule 'as of September 1, 2027').

gpa.notes: No grade minimum. Eligibility page: 'Applicants should demonstrate outstanding academic performance' via transcripts, national exams (ATAR/Abitur/BAC/CSAT/UEC/STPM), international tests (CSCA/SAT/ACT/A-Level/AP/IB) - prose only. Decision is 'a holistic evaluation of academic performance, language proficiency, supporting materials, and the results of the Comprehensive Assessment' (Application Procedures).
